1. A method (400) for assisting a medical procedure on a patient (106), wherein the method (400) comprises, under the control of a computing device (130):
acquiring (406), by the computing device (130), a luminescence image (205F)
of a field of view (103) containing a region of interest (109) for the medical procedure of the patient (106), the region of interest (109) comprising at least one target body (112) of the medical procedure containing a luminescence substance, and one or more foreign objects (115-124) different from the region of interest (109), the luminescence image (205F) comprising a plurality of luminescence values representative of a luminescence light being emitted by the luminescence substance at corresponding luminescence locations of the field of view (103), acquiring (408), by the computing device (130), an auxiliary image (205R) of the field of view (103), the auxiliary image (205R) comprising a plurality of auxiliary values representative of an auxiliary light, different from the luminescence light, being received from corresponding auxiliary locations of the field of view (103), identifying (410-424), by the computing device (130), an auxiliary informative region (210Ri) of the auxiliary image (205R) representative of the region of interest (109) without the foreign objects (115-124) according to a content of the auxiliary image (205R), identifying (428), by the computing device (130), a luminescence informative region (210Fi) of the luminescence image (205F) corresponding to the auxiliary informative region (210Ri), generating (432-466), by the computing device (130), a processed luminescence image (220Fi,225Fi) by processing the luminescence image (205F) limited to the luminescence informative region (210Fi), the processing of the luminescence image (205F) being based on the luminescence values of the luminescence informative region (210Fi) for facilitating an identification of a representation of the target body (112) therein, and
outputting (468-470), by the computing device (130), an output image based
on the processed luminescence image (220Fi,225Fi).
2. The method (400) according to claim 1, wherein the method (400) is for assisting a surgical procedure on the patient (106), said outputting (468-470) the output image comprising:
displaying (470), by the computing device (130), the output image substantially in real-time with said acquiring (406) the luminescence image (205F).
3. The method (400) according to claim 2, wherein the region of interest is a surgical cavity (109) of the patient (106).
4. The method (400) according to any claim from 1 to 3, wherein at least part of the foreign objects (115-124) overlaps the region of interest (109).
5. The method (400) according to any claim from 1 to 4, wherein the foreign objects (115-124) comprise one or more medical instruments (115), one or more hands (118), one or more medical tools (121), one or more body-parts (124) of the patient (106) not of interest for the medical procedure and/or background materials (125).
6. The method (400) according to any claim from 1 to 5, wherein the auxiliary image is a reflectance image (205R), the auxiliary light is a visible light and the auxiliary values are representative of the visible light being reflected by the corresponding auxiliary locations of the field of view (103) illuminated by a white light.
7. The method (400) according to any claim from 1 to 6, wherein the luminescence substance is a luminescence agent being pre-administered to the patient (106) before performing the method (400).
8. The method (400) according to any claim from 1 to 7, wherein said identifying (410-424) the auxiliary informative region (210Ri) comprises:
segmenting (414-424), by the computing device (130), the auxiliary image (205R) semantically into the auxiliary informative region (210Ri) corresponding to at least one region of interest class of the region of interest (109) and an auxiliary non- informative region (210Rn) corresponding to one or more foreign object classes of the foreign objects (115-124).
9. The method (400) according to claim 8, wherein said segmenting (410-424) the auxiliary image (205R) comprises:
segmenting (424), by the computing device (130), the auxiliary image (205R) semantically with a neural network.
10. The method (400) according to claim 8, wherein said segmenting (410-424) the auxiliary image (205R) comprises:
determining (418), by the computing device (130), one or more feature maps for corresponding features of the auxiliary image (205R), each of the feature maps comprising corresponding feature values of the auxiliary locations, and
segmenting (420-422), by the computing device (130), the auxiliary image (205R) semantically by applying a classification algorithm to the feature values of the feature maps.
11. The method (400) according to any claim from 1 to 10, wherein said identifying (410-424) the auxiliary informative region (210Ri) comprises, when the auxiliary image (205R) comprises one or more disconnected portions completely surrounded by the auxiliary informative region (210Ri):
assigning (422), by the computing device (130), the disconnected portions to the auxiliary informative region (210Ri).
12. The method (400) according to any claim from 1 to 11, wherein the method (400) comprises:
pre-processing (410), by the computing device (130), the auxiliary image (205R) before said identifying (412-424) the auxiliary informative region (210Ri) by applying a histogram equalization to the auxiliary image (205R) in response to a brightness indicator of the auxiliary image (205R) being comprised between a
darkness threshold, indicative of a feasibility of said identifying (410-424) the auxiliary informative region (210Ri), and a brightness threshold, higher than the darkness threshold.
13. The method (400) according to any claim from 1 to 12, wherein said identifying (410-424) the auxiliary informative region (210Ri) comprises:
identifying (414-424), by the computing device (130), the auxiliary informative region (210Ri) further according to a content of the luminescence image (205F).
14. The method (400) according to any claim from 1 to 13, wherein said generating (432-466) the processed luminescence image (220Fi,225Fi) comprises:
auto-scaling (436-446), by the computing device (130), the luminescence informative region (210Fi) according to the luminescence values of the luminescence informative region (210Fi).
15. The method (400) according to claim 14, wherein said auto-scaling (436- 446) the luminescence informative region (210Fi) comprises:
determining (436), by the computing device (130), a luminescence range of the luminescence values of the luminescence informative region (210Fi), and
converting (438-446), by the computing device (130), the luminescence values of the luminescence informative region (210Fi) according to a mapping function mapping the luminescence range to a display range for displaying the luminescence
image (205F).
16. The method (400) according to any claim from 1 to 13, wherein said generating (432-466) the processed luminescence image (220Fi,225Fi) comprises:
thresholding (448-464), by the computing device (130), the luminescence informative region (210Fi) according to the luminescence values of the luminescence
informative region (210Fi) thereby partitioning the luminescence informative region (210Fi) into a target segment representative of the target body (112) and a non-target segment representative of a rest of the region of interest (109) different from the target body (112), and wherein said outputting (468-470) the output image comprises:
outputting (470), by the computing device (130), the output image by highlighting the target segment with respect to the non-target segment.
17. The method (400) according to claim 16, wherein said thresholding (448- 464) the luminescence informative region (210Fi) comprises:
determining (448), by the computing device (130), a threshold value according
to a statistical distribution of the luminescence values of the luminescence informative (210Fi), and
assigning (450-460), by the computing device (130), each of the luminescence locations of the luminescence informative region (210Fi) to the target segment or to
the non-target segment according to a comparison of the corresponding luminescence value with the threshold value.
18. The method (400) according to claim 16 or 17, wherein said thresholding (448-464) the luminescence informative region (210Fi) comprises:
calculating (462), by the computing device (130), one or more target statistical
parameters of the luminescence values of the target segment and/or one or more non- target statistical parameters of the luminescence values of the non-target segment, and
updating (464), by the computing device (130), the luminescence values of the target segment each according to the target statistical parameters and/or the non-target statistical parameters.
19. The method (400) according to any claim from 1 to 18, wherein the method (400) comprises:
determining (426), by the computing device (130), corresponding optical values, of at least one optical parameter relating to the luminescence light, for the auxiliary locations of the auxiliary image (205F) limited to the auxiliary informative
region (210Ri) according to a content thereof, and wherein said generating (432-466) the processed luminescence image (220Fi,225Fi) comprises:
equalizing (432), by the computing device (130), the luminescence values of the luminescence informative region (210Fi) according to the optical values.
20. The method (400) according to any claim from 1 to 19, wherein the luminescence substance is a fluorescence substance, the luminescence image being a fluorescence image (205F) and the luminescence values being representative of a fluorescence light emitted by the fluorescence substance at the corresponding luminescence locations illuminated by an excitation light thereof.
21. A computer program (300) configured for causing a computing device (130) to perform the method (400) according to any claim from 1 to 20 when the computer program (300) is executed on the computing device (130).
22. A computer program product comprising one or more computer readable storage media having program instructions collectively stored on the readable storage media, the program instructions readable by a computing device to cause the computing device to perform the method of any claim from 1 to 20.
23. A computing device (130) comprising means (300) configured for performing the steps of the method (400) according to any claim from 1 to 20.
24. An imaging system (100) comprising:
the computing device (130) of claim
23, an illumination unit (133,139) for applying an excitation light adapted to exciting the luminescence substance to the field of view (103), and
an acquisition unit (145-157) for acquiring the luminescence image (205F) and
the auxiliary image (205R).
25. A medical procedure on a patient comprising:
imaging a field of view containing a region of interest for the medical procedure of the patient, the region of interest comprising at least one target body of the medical procedure containing a luminescence substance, and one or more foreign
objects different from the region of interest according to the method of any claim from 1 to 20 to output the output image, and
performing the medical procedure with an assistance of the output image.
26. The medical procedure according to claim 25, wherein the medical procedure comprises:
administering a luminescence agent containing the luminescence substance to the patient. 5 10 15 20 25
